question: How much śakti-vibration is determined beforehand for the sixteen-syllabled mantra declared from visarga?
premises: In supreme Śaiva, having done [the rite], the sixteen-syllabled [mantra] is declared from visarga.
There, so much śakti-vibration is determined beforehand.
inference: The verse links the sixteen-syllabled visarga-declared mantra with a predetermined measure of śakti-vibration.
uncertainties: The object of kṛtvā is not specified.
Whether ṣoḍaśārṇā refers specifically to a mantra is inferred.
The exact quantity of śakti-vibration is left as “so much.”
plain_english: Having done [the rite] in supreme Śaiva, the sixteen-syllabled [mantra] is declared from visarga; there, so much śakti-vibration is determined beforehand.
